scope: Bounded traditional meanings for Knowledge Explorer research. These are not calculation inputs, rules, scores, personalised claims or production content.

provenanceBoundary.independence: One pinned textual lineage; no independent school or Nam Phái verification.
provenanceBoundary.rights: Minimal, bounded public transcription review; normalized paraphrases only and no retained source full text.
